auxiliary_quotation.auxiliary_numerals: Literal unary S^n(0), constructed by pa_unary_term
auxiliary_quotation.canonical_code: Unshared postorder normalized core syntax, constructed by pa_core_canonical
auxiliary_quotation.code_bridge: PA-internal target-normalization invariance; never numerical equality of distinct presentation codes
auxiliary_quotation.numeral_bridge: PA derivation of equality between fixed unary/Horner terms denoting the same natural; never reflexivity-by-evaluation

D1.argument: An actual accepted finite proof has a numeralwise PA proof of its computation graph; existential introduction.
D1.independent_review: Accepted: a particular finite proof supplies a numeralwise PA-verified accepting computation and existential introduction. No consistency assumption enters this external derivability rule.
D1.title: Local derivability

D1_UNIFORM.argument: Fixed proof of universal closure plus explicit closed-term UI+MP transformer for every unary parameter value.
D1_UNIFORM.independent_review: Accepted: the fixed proof of a universal closure is extended by checked universal-instantiation axioms and MP for arbitrary closed unary numerals. Repeated instantiation and its correctness have PA induction proofs. No uniform whole-proof substitution assumption is hidden.
D1_UNIFORM.title: Uniform theorem instances

D2.argument: Exact proof concatenation and rule-specific index shifting, proved by induction on the second proof rows.
D2.independent_review: Accepted: independently decoded join output shifts exactly MP references and the GEN premise reference. The row-prefix induction works uniformly for every valid input pair; GEN variable and axiom witnesses remain unchanged.
D2.title: Uniform MP closure

D2_UNIFORM.argument: Apply the same exact join transformer to primitive-recursive canonical codes after unary insertion.
D2_UNIFORM.independent_review: Accepted by the same uniform join lemma and PA-provable identities of canonical implication/substitution constructors.
D2_UNIFORM.title: Uniform implication closure

D3.argument: Sigma1 completeness, equivalence transport using D1/D2, fixed numeral equality and exact normalized-target invariance.
D3.independent_review: Accepted: transfer Sigma1 completeness from chi to the fixed raw sigma through its PA equivalence and D1/D2, then use normalized-target invariance. A fixed unary/Horner numeral equality changes terms denoting one number; normalized-target invariance changes provability targets with different presentation numbers. These are distinct proved steps.
D3.title: Positive introspection

IC.argument: Record, normalization, pending-stack, call-selector, liveness, proof-prefix and beta/CRT induction invariants.
IC.independent_review: Accepted after independent review of all checker functions, source/compiler induction invariants and primitive-recursive termination bounds. The internal PA reasoning, including nonstandard coded finite inputs, is essential; standard-number agreement alone was not used.
IC.title: PA-internal correctness

SIGMA1_COMPLETENESS.argument: Kurahashi Theorem2.18 with the checked unary/core hypotheses, without silently changing the productive Horner convention.
SIGMA1_COMPLETENESS.independent_review: Accepted after directly inspecting Kurahashi arXiv1902.00895v3 Definition2.12, Theorem2.18 and Lemma3.2. The theorem is applied to the same provability formula using one consistent auxiliary unary/core quotation, with its actual uniform hypotheses established.
SIGMA1_COMPLETENESS.title: Imported uniform theorem

SIGMA1_EQUIVALENCE.argument: Existential bounded-order graph, exact capture-free expansion and PA arithmetical-hierarchy normal-form equivalence.
SIGMA1_EQUIVALENCE.independent_review: Accepted: the explicit existential bounded-order graph and its fresh-variable expansion provide a PA-equivalent Sigma1 presentation. Standard arithmetic normal-form conversion applies; the raw AST is not mislabelled syntactically prenex Sigma1.
SIGMA1_EQUIVALENCE.title: Raw/ bounded formula correspondence

U_QUOTE.argument: Canonical unshared core syntax plus literal unary numerals; constructor/substitution identities by structural induction.
U_QUOTE.independent_review: Accepted: the auxiliary map is injective on normalized core trees, not on arbitrary DAG presentations. Canonical postorder traversal duplicates shared occurrences; unary successor insertion satisfies the literal identity needed by the imported theorem.
U_QUOTE.title: Auxiliary quotation

independent_finite_corroboration.role: Separate tuple/bit-grammar oracle corroborates implementation; these cases are not the proof of the schemes.
